Background of the Project FRESHWAY is a four-year project that aims to strengthen Ethiopia’s fruit and vegetable agrologists system along the Arba Minch–Hawassa–Addis Ababa–Mojo corridor. It focuses on reducing postharvest losses, improving food safety, and attracting private investment in cold chain infrastructure, aggregation, and market linkages, in line with the national Postharvest Management Strategy and growing market demand. Market integration: Establishing private sector-led aggregation hubs to link farmers with markets, improve product quality, and increase incomes. Export promotion: Supporting selected farms and companies to access regional and international markets, including through the Mojo cool port. Capacity building: Enhancing agrologists training and workforce development through A-TVETs, focusing on cold chains, certification, and postharvest management. At TalentPop, we're growing our team and looking for a creative, organized, and TikTok-savvy Influencer Marketing Assistant to join us. In this role, you'll help support influencer campaigns, social media initiatives, and customer engagement strategies. We're seeking someone with at least 1 year of experience in influencer marketing or customer support who is excited to contribute to a fast-paced, remote-first environment. What You’ll Do Monitor TikTok trends and suggest relevant, brand-aligned content ideas Assist with managing the TikTok content calendar and coordinating with creators or internal teams Research and shortlist potential influencers for brand collaborations Manage outreach via DMs or email and maintain communication logs Coordinate timelines, deliverables, and expectations with influencers Track and report on influencer campaign performance and engagement metrics Optional: Respond to TikTok DMs and comments using the client’s brand voice What We Offer Competitive pay with annual performance-based increases Paid time off so you can rest and recharge Health and dental insurance or a health stipend to make you feel your best! Holiday bonuses in appreciation of your hard work Fully remote setup — work from anywhere you're comfortable Opportunities to grow with us as we scale What We’re Looking For At least 1 year of experience in influencer marketing, outreach, or customer support Strong familiarity with TikTok and its creator culture Excellent written English and messaging etiquette Organized and able to manage schedules, content, and influencer pipelines Comfortable using Google Workspace, TikTok, and CRM or influencer platforms Self-starter with a strong work ethic and attention to detail What You’ll Need To Work From Home Your own computer or laptop (i5 processor or equivalent preferred) A stable internet connection (at least 25 Mbps upload/download speed) READY TO JOIN US? If you have TikTok and influencer marketing experience and are excited to support growing brands from home, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and grow your career with TalentPop!
